name: fse-hotreload
title: FSE hot reload
author: mtopfox
description: For mod developers: edits to a mod's source folder (FSE_HOTRELOAD in fse.env) reach the running singleplayer game in half a second (control.lua reloaded, storage kept); data.lua changes wait for a Restart button. Does nothing without fse or FSE_HOTRELOAD.
